data.case_title: Working hours increase – Beispielsoft Solutions GmbH
data.title: Notice of increased working hours from January 2027
data.summary: Beispielsoft Solutions GmbH's People & Culture department informs Harriet Collins that, following her review meeting, her weekly working hours will rise from 32 to 40 from 1 January 2027, with her salary adjusted accordingly. She must sign and return one copy of the enclosed contract amendment by 11 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your employer is increasing your contracted weekly hours from 32 to 40 starting 1 January 2027, and your pay will be adjusted to match. An amendment to your employment contract is enclosed for you to sign. Sign both copies and send one back to People & Culture by the deadline shown, so payroll can process the change in time for January. If you have concerns about the new hours or pay, raise them with People & Culture before signing; otherwise returning it late may delay the change taking effect in your first January payslip.

change.quote:
As agreed in your review meeting, your weekly hours will rise from 32 to 40 from 1
January 2027, with your salary adjusted accordingly.

items.title: Sign and return the contract amendment
items.quote:
Please sign both copies and return one to People & Culture by 11 December 2026 so
that payroll can apply the change in January.
items.action: Sign both copies of the enclosed contract amendment and return one signed copy to People & Culture.
items.consequence: If it is not returned in time, payroll may not be able to apply the hours and salary change from January.
